approved_language_for_phase13c: No robust predictive relationship was established under the tested configurations.

Two linear baseline candidates (ridge/lasso on FS-12B-A) retained positive out-of-sample rank information in 6 of 8 sequential evaluation windows and across four tested universes, but window-level statistical significance was not established (p≈0.20, CI includes zero).
Candidate effects are concentrated in the 2023–2025 sub-period and absent in 2022 and in nonlinear models.
A candidate relationship survived specified robustness tests but economic usefulness remains unproven.
canonical_conclusion: No convincing, robust predictive relationship has been established across Phases 9-13B. Sequential evaluation isolated a weak, linear-only, post-2022 rank-information effect in two baseline-OHLCV candidates; it is statistically insignificant at the window level, concentrated in one sub-period, and economically unvalidated.
